items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Lee Stanfield was bass... Bobby Smith, Ace Harris, Sonny Payne, Lee Stanfield, and Sammy Lowe. That was one of the trombone players... I took Avery, Lee, the bass player, Stanfield, Big Jack, the drummer, and McLemore, the guitar at that time.

ctx.x: Oh, James Morrison Marshall was drums. Lee Stanfield was bass. Avery Parrish was piano, and William McLamore was guitar.
